quotes.text: - Responsabilidades de cuidado de hijos u otros familiares
- Dedicado a las labores del hogar

assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire records care responsibilities and domestic work only as reasons for working part-time, reasons for not seeking employment, or as a self-reported current activity status ('Dedicado a las labores del hogar'). The instrument does not contain any question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other tasks or outside of care being their main activity.
